column1: # The CRSP US-market index's OWN time under water, on the model's definition: share of sessions
# more than 5/10/20 percent below the running peak, fresh-start seeding, from the 202606-vintage
# F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily total return (Mkt-RF + RF) -- the same series and windows as
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The depth rungs are graded against a relation fitted on 35 FUNDS over
# 2001-2026, and the 0.23.0 valuation cycle pushed the model's d10/d20 readings up (1.28 / 2.74 at
# the shipped default).  Whether that is a regression depends on the ruler: against the modern-fund
# relation's ~0.21 / 0.055 at ~16% volatility, the INDEX ITSELF reads 0.269 / 0.126 post-1954 and
# 0.386 / 0.255 over the century -- ratios of roughly 1.3 / 2.3 (post-war) and 1.8 / 4.6 (century).
# The model's shipped shares (0.24 / 0.126, median path) sit between the fund cross-section and the
# post-war index, and below both index windows on d20.  The fund relation stays the graded anchor
# (it is the only cross-sectional one); this file is the disclosure that the relation's window has
# no depression in it and the index runs deeper.  Nothing is fitted from this file.
